basis: The fixed candidate has lower whole-block development MSE than every comparator under independent noise but higher MSE than every comparator under matched noise. The frozen gate requires improvement against all comparators in both regimes.
practical_finding: In both regimes the candidate and repairing every case once have weighted observed terminal success 0.796875. The candidate applies 61 repairs, but requires 63 dry-run repair computations plus transfer features; repairing every case uses 63 repair computations without those features.
interpretation_limits: All paired outcomes were exposed before this candidate was specified; leaving acquisition blocks out of fitted models does not make this a prospective validation.
Only 13 discordant record/regime pairs across 16 acquisition blocks; a failed candidate does not establish that repair benefit is unlearnable.
Offline policy diagnostics have different resource vectors and are not an equal-total-budget scheduling experiment.
The earlier paired pilot remains unresolved; this comparison does not qualify the benefit of repairing every case.
No RDT-specific predictive law is established.
continuation: This version ends at the failed gate. Any revised hypothesis requires a new version and must be identified as outcome-informed development.
